module: Flowgraph node "Sevensegment Display" (repeat_instant, author BeamNG). Creates a seven-segment display made of TSStatic (art/shapes/quarter_mile_display/display_*.dae) at the given position/rotation and displays the number of the number pin on it. Settings in self.data: mode ('number', 'minutes', 'hours'), scaling, count (5 digits), decimals (3), decimalOffset, spacing, shapeFolder, showLeadingZeroes. Output: number.
notes: The output pin number is never written.
The 'hours' and 'number' modes have no distinct logic: only 'minutes' adds the colon.
If the number pin is nil, updateNumbers fails (division of nil).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Initializes the default settings (mode 'minutes', count 5, decimals 3, spacing 5...).

createObjects.desc: Creates the digits (shape '8'), the decimal point and, in minutes mode, the colon.

makeDot.desc: Creates a point TSStatic (shape 'period') offset relative to the base position.

updateNumbers.desc: Changes the shape of each digit according to the current number; clears leading zeros if showLeadingZeroes is false.

clearObjects.desc: Deletes all created objects and sets spawned back to false.

work.desc: On clear, deletes the display; otherwise creates it if needed and updates the digits if the number changed.

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-mission hook: cleans up the objects created by the node.

destroy.desc: Called when the node is destroyed: cleans up the created objects.
